text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A complete overhaul of Harare's traffic management system, is being carried out in in an attempt to tame the city's traffic jungle.

- A Zambian politician woke up on Sunday morning to find himself in the wrong hotel room in Harare, with his money and travel documents missing. He could not remember how he ended up there, nor what happened to him while he was in the room.
